title: Final Values
description: Essential Criteria: The correct values for R, L, and C must be provided.

title: Circuit Configuration
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the configuration of R, L, and C in the circuit.

title: Impedance Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of how to calculate impedance in the circuit.

title: Resonance Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of resonance and its effect on current must be included.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent and correctly applied throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating impedance or resonance frequency.

title: Voltage and Current Relationship
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between voltage and current in the DC and AC cases must be correctly analyzed.

title: Derivation Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The clarity and correctness of any derivations used to find L and C should be assessed.
